tweets.text:
Qwen3.8-27B can now be run locally! ✨

Run on 17GB RAM via Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs.

Qwen3.8-27B is by far the strongest model for its size. We also uploaded NVFP4 quants.

GGUF: https://t.co/xIdNwm7CLQ
Guide: https://t.co/J2PwgMP6GZ https://t.co/NKFJuPXFyG

We promised open weights for Qwen3.8. Now, time to meet them! 🎉

⚡ Qwen3.8-27B:
- A native multimodal dense model. With just 27B parameters, it outperforms Qwen3.7-Plus overall and shines in real-world coding & office workflows.
- 262K native context, easily extendable to 1M https://t.co/QuN8oWkG4C

@Alibaba_Qwen You can now run and train Qwen3.8-27B locally in Unsloth Desktop! 🦥

We also did a new release with a lot of new releases and performance improvements! https://t.co/aZWYAtakBP

@UnslothAI @Alibaba_Qwen Thanks @Alibaba_Qwen and @UnslothAI 

My config llama.cpp config:
```
[qwen38-27b]
hf = unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
ctx-size = 262144
np = 1
fa = on
fit = off
gpu-layers = all
temperature = 1.0
top-p = 0.95
top-k = 20
min-p = 0.00
cache-type-k = q4_0
cache-type-v = q4_0 https://t.co/waQnu2hJrz
